identificationModule.briefTitle: AZD9291 Versus Placebo in Patients With Stage IB-IIIA Non-small Cell Lung Carcinoma, Following Complete Tumour Resection With or Without Adjuvant Chemotherapy.
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase III, Double-blind, Randomized, Placebo-controlled Multi-centre, Study to Assess the Efficacy and Safety of AZD9291 Versus Placebo, in Patients With Epidermal Growth Factor Receptor Mutation Positive Stage IB-IIIA Non-small Cell Lung Carcinoma, Following Complete Tumour Resection With or Without Adjuvant Chemotherapy (ADAURA).

armGroups.label: AZD9291
armGroups.description: AZD9291 (80 mg or 40 mg orally, once daily), in accordance with the randomization schedule.

armGroups.label: Placebo AZD9291
armGroups.description: Matching placebo for AZD9291 (80 mg or 40 mg orally, once daily), in accordance with the randomization schedule.

interventions.name: AZD9291 80 mg/40 mg
interventions.description: The initial dose of AZD9291 80 mg once daily can be reduced to 40 mg once daily.

interventions.name: Placebo AZD9291 80 mg/40 mg
interventions.description: The initial dose of Placebo AZD9291 80 mg once daily can be reduced to 40 mg once daily.

interventions.name: Open-label AZD9291 80 mg/40 mg
interventions.description: Eligible patients will be offered open-label osimertinib upon recurrence and in the absence of intervening systemic anti-cancer therapy.
